```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source("R/gallery.R")
```

```{r}
#| label: page-heading
tagList(
  section_heading("Portfolio"),
  tags$div(
    class = "category-nav",
    tags$a(href = "#landscapes",   class = "category-btn", "Landscapes"),
    tags$a(href = "#portraits",    class = "category-btn", "Portraits"),
    tags$a(href = "#street",       class = "category-btn", "Street"),
    tags$a(href = "#architecture", class = "category-btn", "Architecture")
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: landscapes
landscapes <- data.frame(
  seed = paste0("land", 1:6),
  title = c(
    "Mountain vista at sunrise",
    "Coastal cliffs at dusk",
    "Forest path in autumn",
    "Desert sand dunes",
    "Lake reflection at dawn",
    "Rolling hills at golden hour"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

gallery_section(
  id       = "landscapes",
  heading  = "Landscapes",
  subtitle = "Light, land, and open horizons",
  photos   = landscapes
)
```
